Theorem
[Classification of ancient solutions on the two-sphere] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0090 ↗ prop:chow-iv-q-vanishes-backward ↗ prop:chow-iv-q-zero-characterizes-king-rosenau 1. ch29:29.1\group Compact Ancient Solutions

Every compact simply connected ancient solution to the Ricci flow in dimension two is either a round shrinking two-sphere or the rotationally symmetric King--Rosenau solution.
